## What changed

### 1. D-META.1-1 (BL-045) — ruleset calibration over the real spine → DONE

`docs/build/reports/2026-09-16_ruleset_calibration.md` — every figure computed
over the hosted spine via the Cloud SQL proxy (append-only reads; no spine row
written). Outcome: **the documented defaults hold; no constant retuned** —
a single-epoch corpus cannot estimate change rates, and tuning unmeasured
constants would violate the defining standard. The corpus did speak where it
can:

- `deployment_exists` (SLOW/3y): 0 value churn across 4,957 subjects.
- `claimed_device_count`: the one real cross-source disagreement (190 vs 299)
  sits *above* the FAST 0.15 tolerance — the constant provably does its job.
- Directness: 99.92% of claims carry the unregistered `connector_run` genre;
  the matrix's grades are unrefuted on the 8 resolvable pairs.
- Atlas supersession: 0 cross-source (subject, predicate) overlap and empty
  `resolution`/`contradiction` tables — the precondition (an ER run) does not
  yet exist; ADR-028's deferral is confirmed correct *on real data*.

Five engineering-actionable follow-on gaps are recorded in the note (registry
coverage of 67 unregistered predicates, `evidence_genre` stamping, USAspending
subject keys, the hosted-spine resolver run, `observed_at` coverage).

### 2. D-META.1-2 (BL-028) — records-request outcome backend, fed live → DONE

- `tasks/src/tasks/request_outcomes.py` — append-only JSONL
  `RequestOutcomeLog`: request id, agency, coarse `state`
  (filed/acknowledged/in-flight/completed) + precise §11.19
  `response_status`, filed/response dates, observation source and vocabulary
  version. `outcome_from_claims` folds the spine's predicate surface;
  `outcome_from_api_payload` parses a platform api_v2 object through the
  caller-supplied versioned status map — an unmapped status fails loud.
  `feed_template_log` is the explicit feed into the P10.3
  `TemplateOutcomeLog`: `no_responsive_records` is never a template failure
  (SIG-TASK-009) and in-flight observations never move a rate.
- `tasks/src/tasks/data/request_outcomes.toml` — the status→state map and
  template success/exclusion lists as versioned data, total over the frozen
  §11.19 enum (enum-totality test).
- `sig-tasks records-outcomes record|show` CLI.
- `docs/build/tools/records_outcome_feed.py` — the live feeder (`--spine` /
  `--live REQUEST_ID` through the connector's own politeness layer + JWT
  cache).

**Live evidence (2026-09-16):** Cloud Run `sig-ingest-muckrock` executed for
real (execution `sig-ingest-muckrock-fx2ch`, exit 0) — the api_v2 pull was
attempted and the API currently challenges even GCP egress, so 0 new claims

Request **136412's real recorded state** (fulfilled, agency 265, response
2022-11-30T20:10:37-05:00) was folded from the spine into
`docs/build/reports/records_outcomes_2026-09-16.jsonl`. **No outcome was
fabricated from the challenged pulls.** Templates remain generation-only;
filing itself stays out of scope (HG-09).
